cmd: python builders/zim.py --id wikimed --flavours medicine_nopic --topic medical --name 'WikiMed medical encyclopedia' --description "Wikipedia's medicine articles: diseases, symptoms, drugs, anatomy, procedures and first aid. Text only." --queries 'migraine aura;anaphylaxis treatment;heat stroke;ankle sprain'
description: Wikipedia's medicine articles (about 71,000): diseases, symptoms, drugs, anatomy and procedures, in full. Overlaps with MedlinePlus (the same conditions in plain language) and FDA drug labels (official drug details).

cmd: python builders/medlineplus.py
description: About 1,000 plain-language health topics written by the U.S. National Library of Medicine (MedlinePlus): conditions, tests, symptoms and wellness. Small. Overlaps with WikiMed, which covers the same conditions in more technical depth.

cmd: python builders/fda_labels.py
description: Official U.S. drug labels (FDA) for prescription and over-the-counter medicines: uses, dosing, contraindications, warnings, side effects and interactions, one entry per drug. Overlaps with drug articles in WikiMed and with the online FDA lookup when Internet is on (this works offline).

cmd: python builders/zim.py --id wiki-essentials --flavours 'top_mini|top_nopic' --topic general --name 'Wikipedia essentials' --description "The opening section of Wikipedia's most-read articles: people, places, history, science and culture." --queries 'Abraham Lincoln;photosynthesis;Mount Everest;World War II'
description: Only the first section (the summary) of each of Wikipedia's 50,000 most-read articles: people, places, history, science and culture. Overlaps with the Wikipedia science, history and geography packs, which have the full articles.

cmd: python builders/zim.py --id wiki-science --flavours 'physics_nopic,chemistry_nopic,molcell_nopic,astronomy_nopic,mathematics_nopic,earth_sciences_nopic|geology_nopic' --topic science --name 'Wikipedia science' --description 'Wikipedia articles on physics, chemistry, biology, astronomy, earth science and mathematics. Text only.' --queries 'speed of light;periodic table;mitochondria;black hole'
description: Full Wikipedia articles on physics, chemistry, molecular and cell biology, astronomy and mathematics. Text only. Overlaps a little with WikiMed (biochemistry and drugs) and with Wikipedia essentials (summaries of famous topics).

cmd: python builders/zim.py --id wiki-history --flavours history_nopic --topic general --name 'Wikipedia history' --description 'Full Wikipedia history articles' --queries 'Roman Empire;French Revolution;Civil War'
description: Full Wikipedia articles on world history: civilizations, wars, empires, events and historical figures. Text only. Overlaps with Wikipedia essentials (summaries of the most famous ones) and Wikipedia geography (countries' history sections).

cmd: python builders/zim.py --id wiki-geography --flavours geography_nopic --topic general --name 'Wikipedia geography' --description 'Full Wikipedia geography articles' --queries 'Missouri River;Sahara;Japan climate'
description: Full Wikipedia articles on countries, regions, cities, rivers, mountains and climate. Text only. Overlaps with Wikipedia essentials (summaries), Wikipedia history, and Wikivoyage (which covers travel rather than facts).

cmd: python builders/zim.py --id wikivoyage --dir wikivoyage --prefix wikivoyage_en_ --flavours 'all_nopic|all_maxi' --site https://en.wikivoyage.org/wiki/ --credit 'Text from Wikivoyage, the free travel guide (Wikivoyage contributors), via Kiwix. Licensed CC BY-SA 4.0.' --topic travel --name 'Wikivoyage travel guide' --description 'Wikivoyage travel guide' --queries 'St. Louis;Yellowstone;Tokyo get around'
description: The free Wikivoyage travel guide: destinations, getting around, sights, where to stay, local safety and phrasebooks. Little overlap: Wikipedia geography has facts about places, Wikivoyage has practical travel tips.

cmd: python builders/army.py --pack survival
description: U.S. Army survival manual (ATP 3-50.21) and first-aid manual (TC 4-02.1): shelter, water, fire, signaling, survival medicine, bleeding, burns, fractures. Overlaps with Wild edible plants (similar food chapters) and Navigation & preparedness (its navigation chapter is a shorter version).

cmd: python builders/army.py --pack fieldcraft
description: U.S. Army map reading & land navigation (TC 3-25.26) and FEMA's Are You Ready? emergency preparedness guide: compass and map use, storms, floods, power outages, emergency supplies. Overlaps a little with Army survival (navigation basics).

cmd: python builders/zim.py --id appropedia --dir other --prefix appropedia_en_ --flavours 'all_nopic|all_maxi|all' --site https://www.appropedia.org/ --credit 'Text from Appropedia (Appropedia contributors), via Kiwix. Licensed CC BY-SA 4.0.' --topic survival --english-only --name 'Appropedia (off-grid how-to)' --description 'Appropedia' --queries 'solar cooker;rainwater harvesting;composting toilet'
description: Appropedia's practical how-to wiki for off-grid and sustainable living: water filtration, solar power, cooking, shelter, sanitation, farming. Overlaps a little with Army survival and Navigation & preparedness (water, shelter, emergencies).

cmd: python builders/army.py --pack wildplants
description: U.S. Army field manual chapters on finding and testing wild food plants, the universal edibility test, edible and medicinal plants, and poisonous plants. Overlaps with Wikipedia plants & fungi and USDA PLANTS (same species, different detail).

cmd: python builders/wiki_taxa.py
description: Wikipedia articles on about 42,000 plants, trees, wildflowers, mushrooms and other fungi; full articles for edible, toxic or medicinal species. Overlaps with Wild edible plants (survival use) and USDA PLANTS (names).

cmd: python builders/usda.py
description: Names of every plant in the U.S. from the USDA PLANTS Database: common and scientific names, families, older names. Names only, no descriptions; pairs with Wikipedia plants & fungi and Wild edible plants, which describe them.

cmd: python builders/zim.py --id wikibooks-cookbook --dir wikibooks --prefix wikibooks_en_ --flavours 'all_nopic|all_maxi' --title-prefix 'Cookbook:' --site https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/ --credit 'Text from the Wikibooks Cookbook (Wikibooks contributors), via Kiwix. Licensed CC BY-SA 4.0.' --topic food --name 'Wikibooks Cookbook' --description 'Wikibooks Cookbook' --queries 'bread;pancakes;canning;substitute eggs'
description: The Wikibooks Cookbook: thousands of recipes plus cooking techniques, ingredients, substitutions and food preservation. No overlap with the other packs.

cmd: python builders/canning.py --id usda-canning
description: The USDA Complete Guide to Home Canning (2015): safe canning of fruits, tomatoes, vegetables, meat, fish, pickles, jams and jellies, with processing times by altitude. Small. Overlaps a little with the Wikibooks Cookbook and Cooking Q&A.

cmd: python builders/stackexchange.py --id se-cooking --sites cooking.stackexchange.com,coffee.stackexchange.com,homebrew.stackexchange.com,vegetarianism.stackexchange.com --topic food --name 'Cooking Q&A' --description 'Cooking Q&A' --queries 'sourdough starter;substitute buttermilk;cast iron rust;food safety leftovers'
description: Practical cooking questions answered by cooks (Seasoned Advice), plus coffee, home brewing and vegetarian cooking. Overlaps with the Wikibooks Cookbook (recipes) and USDA canning guide.

cmd: python builders/stackexchange.py --id se-diy --sites diy.stackexchange.com --topic home --name 'Home repair & DIY Q&A' --description 'Home repair & DIY Q&A' --queries 'leaking faucet;circuit breaker tripping;drywall patch;water heater' --answers 2
description: Home improvement questions answered by tradespeople and DIYers: plumbing, electrical, carpentry, heating/cooling, roofing, appliances. Larger download. No overlap with other packs.

cmd: python builders/stackexchange.py --id se-outdoors --sites outdoors.stackexchange.com --topic survival --name 'Outdoors & camping Q&A' --description 'Outdoors & camping Q&A' --queries 'water purification;hypothermia;bear safety;tent condensation'
description: Hiking, camping, backpacking, climbing and wilderness questions from experienced outdoorspeople. Overlaps a little with Army survival & first aid.

cmd: python builders/stackexchange.py --id se-gardening --sites gardening.stackexchange.com --topic plants --name 'Gardening Q&A' --description 'Gardening Q&A' --queries 'tomato leaves yellow;compost;lawn weeds;pruning roses'
description: Gardening and landscaping questions: vegetables, lawns, trees, houseplants, pests and soil. Pairs with Wikipedia plants & fungi and the USDA PLANTS checklist.

cmd: python builders/stackexchange.py --id se-vehicles --sites mechanics.stackexchange.com,bicycles.stackexchange.com --topic home --name 'Car & bike repair Q&A' --description 'Car & bike repair Q&A' --queries 'check engine light;brake pads;battery dead;flat tire;derailleur'
description: Car and motorcycle maintenance and repair (Motor Vehicle Maintenance & Repair) plus bicycle repair and riding questions. No overlap with other packs.

cmd: python builders/stackexchange.py --id se-money --sites money.stackexchange.com --topic general --name 'Personal finance Q&A' --description 'Personal finance Q&A' --queries 'credit score;Roth IRA;mortgage refinance;budget'
description: Personal finance and money questions: budgeting, credit, loans, taxes, retirement accounts, investing basics (mostly US). General information, not financial advice.

cmd: python builders/stackexchange.py --id se-family --sites parenting.stackexchange.com,pets.stackexchange.com --topic general --name 'Parenting & pets Q&A' --description 'Parenting & pets Q&A' --queries 'toddler tantrum;sleep training;dog chewing;cat litter'
description: Parenting questions from babies to teens, and pet care questions (dogs, cats, fish, birds, small animals). No overlap with other packs.

cmd: python builders/stackexchange.py --id se-ham --sites ham.stackexchange.com --topic survival --name 'Ham radio Q&A' --description 'Ham radio Q&A' --queries 'antenna;repeater;license exam;emergency communication'
description: Amateur (ham) radio questions: licensing, antennas, radios, repeaters and emergency communications. Small.

cmd: python builders/stackexchange.py --id se-law --sites law.stackexchange.com --topic general --name 'Law Q&A' --description 'Law Q&A' --queries 'tenant rights;copyright;contract;small claims'
description: Questions about how the law works, answered by lawyers and knowledgeable members (mostly US and UK). General information, not legal advice.

cmd: python builders/stackexchange.py --id se-making --sites woodworking.stackexchange.com,crafts.stackexchange.com,3dprinting.stackexchange.com,sustainability.stackexchange.com,lifehacks.stackexchange.com --topic home --name 'Making & fixing things Q&A' --description 'Making & fixing things Q&A' --queries 'wood glue;finish;sewing;3d print warping;remove stain'
description: Woodworking, crafts, 3D printing, sustainable living and everyday lifehacks. Small. Overlaps a little with Home repair & DIY.

cmd: python builders/stackexchange.py --id se-fitness --sites fitness.stackexchange.com --topic medical --name 'Fitness Q&A' --description 'Fitness Q&A' --queries 'muscle soreness;running;protein;stretching'
description: Exercise, strength training, running and fitness questions. Small. General information, not medical advice.

cmd: python builders/zim.py --id wiki-computers --flavours computer_nopic --topic general --name 'Wikipedia computers & technology' --description 'Wikipedia computers' --queries 'wifi router;malware;USB;operating system'
description: Wikipedia's computing and technology articles: hardware, software, networks, the internet, programming and security. Overlaps a little with Wikipedia essentials and science.

cmd: python builders/zim.py --id wiktionary-simple --dir wiktionary --prefix wiktionary_en_ --flavours simple_all_nopic --site https://simple.wiktionary.org/wiki/ --credit 'Text from the Simple English Wiktionary (Wiktionary contributors), via Kiwix. Licensed CC BY-SA 4.0.' --topic general --name 'Dictionary (Simple English Wiktionary)' --description 'Simple Wiktionary' --queries 'abandon;benevolent;run'
description: A plain-language English dictionary: meanings, word forms and example sentences for about 30,000 words. Tiny.

cmd: python builders/zim.py --id wiki-popular-full --flavours top_nopic --topic general --name 'Wikipedia popular articles (full)' --description 'Wikipedia popular full' --queries 'World War II;photosynthesis;Taylor Swift;Roman Empire'
description: The full text of Wikipedia's most-read articles (not just the opening sections like Wikipedia essentials). Large download. Overlaps with Wikipedia essentials, history, geography and science; pick this one instead of essentials if you have room.
